name: Headache
notes: Odds of reported headache doubled per +1 mmHg CO₂ (2001–2012 ISS data).

name: Stuffy nose / congestion
notes: Congestion associated with CO₂ and appears ~1 mmHg lower than headache.

name: Dizziness
notes: Back on Earth: link with standing test.

name: Blurred or changed vision
notes: SANS sign: decreased near vision / hyperopic shift.

name: Chest pain
notes: Severity ≥1 opens the chest pain card.
